note: The TypeScript control law is the oracle. If the C++ port disagrees, fix the PORT, never this file.

scenarios.name: nominal
scenarios.description: Five-zone demo journey, plant matches the model. Zone attainment, maximum-feasible airflow, the circulation floor and actuator fold-back all fire; the correction stays small.

scenarios.name: weak_heater
scenarios.description: The same journey with the PLANT 20% weaker than the controller believes. The integral must build and hold a steady positive bias.

scenarios.name: saturated_windup
scenarios.description: An unreachable 80 C/min ramp followed by a reachable near-hold. The integral must FREEZE while the plant is pinned (conditional integration and the saturation-direction revert), then resume.

scenarios.name: hold_zone
scenarios.description: A true start-equals-end zone pins the maintenance-hold path in both implementations.

scenarios.name: mid_roast_plan_patch
scenarios.description: At 120 seconds the device-owned plan is replaced in place while control state and zone anchor continue.

scenarios.name: non_reference_mass
scenarios.description: The feasible climb at 300 g pins the reference-mass scaling across TypeScript and C++.

scenarios.name: cool_then_heat
scenarios.description: A cooling zone followed by a heating zone pins direction changes and the return to a heat-bearing solve.

scenarios.name: irregular_cadence
scenarios.description: Irregular 1/2/7/1/12-second samples pin both integration and heat-slew delta-time clamps.

scenarios.name: heavy_mass_immediate_reduction
scenarios.description: At 240 g a slow zone above 130 C holds Fan wide open, then a steep push demands more Heat than Fan 10 permits: Fan falls by whole levels in one tick. No mass floor, no reduction rate limit, no retained reduction.

scenarios.name: heat_on_fan_floor
scenarios.description: A shallow hot zone whose maximum-airflow solve wants Fan below 1 with Heat on. The universal heat-on Fan 1.0 command floor binds and the Heat solve is folded back through it.

scenarios.name: overshoot_lag_recovery
scenarios.description: A recorded 225 g Journey roast replayed: its plan and the fit the device had applied against a hotter, airflow-sensitive plant with 8 s actuation dead time and 10 s probe lag. Pins Heat-first correction allocation (Fan holds 1.0 through zone 3), the lag-compensated rate term relaxing before RoR crosses the slope, and the -12 °C/min cooling bound.

scenarios.name: dropout
scenarios.description: A feasible climb against a 20%-wrong model with the probe dead from 400 s to 430 s. Correction zero, integral frozen, feed-forward solved against the PLAN temperature, clean resume.
